en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, jagged rock pinnacle with a metal statue of a mountain goat or ibex standing on its very top. In the foreground there is a rough footpath and simple wooden railings along the rock. In the distant background, slightly hazy, one can make out buildings and a valley town surrounded by hills. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
